title: EST-CE QUE VOUS COMPUTE? CODE-SWITCHING, CULTURAL IDENTITY, AND AI

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical and philosophical analysis of how AI systems fail to accommodate cultural code-switching, leading to epistemic oppression, double binds, and cultural smothering for marginalized groups.
Literature review and analysis of anglocentric biases in large language model training datasets (e.g., Common Crawl) and the preference for 'broadcast English' dialects in NLP systems.
